scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.bump: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces && npm version patch --workspace=server --no-git-tag-version
scripts.bump:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces && npm version minor --workspace=server --no-git-tag-version
scripts.bump:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces && npm version major --workspace=server --no-git-tag-version
